rubric.evidence: WebIDL verified against W3C WebTransport CR/ED and Blink web_transport_options.idl; default ReadableStream vs ReadableStream::CreateByteStream switching, ShouldSkipEmptyDatagram, and is_byte_typed_array TypeError/RangeError behavior verified directly in Blink web_transport.cc and WPT webtransport/datagrams.https.any.js (fetched 2026-11-24).

Feature 5148774971342848 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=159 with listing name 'WebTransport Datagram readable stream type'; H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5148774971342848.

MDN has no dedicated page for datagramsReadableType (only a subsection under WebTransport() constructor), so a full implementation-sufficient reference was authored. reference-contract.json maps 3 inventory items across all 9 dimensions with verified selectors and surfaceMarkers.

Explains why byte streams lose empty datagrams and message boundaries, documents Chrome 159's breaking default change from byte stream to default ReadableStream, compares both modes in a structured table, and details pullDatagrams BYOB view requirements and the 64 KiB RFC 9221 recommendation.

Two complete semantic <pre><code> examples covering default ReadableStream reading and opt-in BYOB reading with 64 KiB buffer reuse and graceful fallback. No Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists yet (HEAD returned 404 on 2026-11-24).

Discloses BCD options_datagramsReadableType_parameter lagging Chrome 159 (still false in BCD), reports Firefox 160 and Safari Technology Preview / Safari iOS false from BCD, links parent webtransport Baseline Newly available (2026-03-24) honestly without overclaiming Baseline for this option, and provides backwards-compatible migration guidance.

Zero unlinked source labels; every spec, Blink source, WPT, BCD, webstatus.dev, ChromeStatus, Bugzilla, WebKit Bugzilla, blink-dev intent, and MDN citation carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with tabindex='0' role='region' aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

Uses shared /public/styles.css tokens without overriding pre/h1/code/.baseline-browsers inline, logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap scrollers, and verified via npm run responsive -- --page v159/webtransport-datagram-readable-stream-type.

HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v159/webtransport-datagram-readable-stream-type/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no broken iframe or speculative link emitted so manifest demo remains honestly null.
